concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-local-payment-methods-overview]] - unversioned Local Payment Methods developer overview for customer-country inventory, transaction-limit locators, non-instant labels, client/server routes, unsupported vaulting and recurring use, method-specific access and deprecation qualifications, and unresolved same-date EUR-versus-limit-currency tension
warnings: The table's current-support label conflicts with its dated Giropay and Sofort end-of-support notices; MyBank is limited access and Swish is Web-SDK-only.

The same-date article-level owner says Local Payment Method transactions are automatically presented in EUR, while the overview table expresses limits in EUR, PLN, BRL, GBP, MXN and SEK; the sources do not explain the relationship and must not be harmonized.

The overview identifies three methods as non-instant but does not establish that every unlabelled method is instant, and it provides no SDK-version, environment, execution, settlement or funding proof.

The existing source-braintree-payment-methods-local-payment-methods page remains the article-level owner; this proposal adds a reciprocal route to the separate developer overview and does not overwrite that owner.
